description: Source code for a web scraper class 'CarriesExperimentalKitchen' that extracts recipe ingredients and equipment list from a specific website.

classes.name: CarriesExperimentalKitchen
classes.description: A scraper class for 'carriesexperimentalkitchen.com' that extracts equipment and ingredient groups from recipe pages.

methods.name: host
methods.description: Returns the hostname of the target website.

methods.name: equipment
methods.description: Extracts and returns a list of equipment needed for the recipe.

methods.name: ingredient_groups
methods.description: Returns ingredient groups excluding equipment, with their purposes.

methods.name: ingredients
methods.description: Extracts and returns a flat list of ingredients from the recipe.
